title: Systems over features
description: Functionality is transient; the integrity of the underlying system is what enables longevity.

title: Correctness before scale
description: Premature optimization is the root of failure. Ensure the logic holds before widening the pipe.

title: Explicit ownership
description: Code without a clear owner or boundary is technical debt by definition.

title: Build for failure
description: Assume components will fail. Design systems that degrade gracefully rather than collapsing.

title: Boring tech, deliberate architecture
description: Use proven tools to solve complex problems. Reserve innovation for the architecture, not the stack.
